name: Defending God
overview: Scripture teaches that God’s justice and holiness must be upheld, as seen in Exodus 22:2 where defending what is right may require decisive action. Job 36:12 warns of the consequences of disobedience leading to perishing without knowledge, highlighting the seriousness of rejecting God’s ways. Yet, the gospel offers hope through Christ, who was given out of God's great love so that believers may have eternal life (John 3:16). Therefore, Christians are called to boldly proclaim the gospel, unashamed of its power to save all who believe (Romans 1:16).
